legacy_cells.C: Shernazarov, Ulugbek, Xu, Moucheng, Ramatov, Inomjon
legacy_cells.S: Given later diseased brain MRI observations, reconstruct the same patients’ unobserved earlier, healthier anatomy.
legacy_cells.T: ADNI subjects with at least five valid dated visits and non-missing diagnosis; latest five visits used.
legacy_cells.AI: T1-weighted longitudinal brain MRI volumes; simulated 3D Morpho-MNIST digit volumes
legacy_cells.AJ: 3D VQ-GAN encoder; ConvGRU recurrent encoder for observed latent sequence
legacy_cells.BL: ADNI median visit times 0, 278, 465, 752, and 1120 days; normalized to [0, 1].
legacy_cells.BP: Reverse-order observed latent sequence; ADNI latest five visits (single-scan inference also evaluated).
legacy_cells.BS: Reconstructed earlier MRI frames from predicted latent states.
legacy_cells.BV: Stage 1 VQ-GAN: reconstruction, adversarial, and perceptual terms. Stage 2: L = 0.2Ldirect + Linter (direct latent error plus intermediate frame-difference loss).
legacy_cells.CD: Four earlier frames (t=0–3) predicted from later observations in the reported Morpho-MNIST experiment.
legacy_cells.DY: Multi-step predicted-frame results: Morpho-MNIST MSE 0.00561±0.00040, PSNR 20.27±0.16, SSIM 0.5361±0.0013; registered ADNI MSE 0.00238 and SSIM 0.574.
legacy_cells.EA: Registered ADNI: overall dynamics ratio 1.29±0.23 and disease-reversal score −1.88; reversal scores were negative in all reported diagnostic strata.
legacy_cells.EI: Baselines: VQ copy-nearest and VQ mean-observed; registered ADNI SSIM 0.454 and 0.470 versus Neural ODE 0.574. Pixel baselines had lower MSE but bypassed the autoencoder.
legacy_cells.EK: Ablations/findings: undertrained checkpoint (synthetic thickness correlation r=0.039); model capacity/perceptual-loss comparison; single-scan inference; registered versus unregistered ADNI pipeline.
legacy_cells.EL: Registered ADNI predictions overshot anatomical change (dynamics ratio 1.29±0.23) and had negative disease-reversal scores in every diagnostic stratum; authors report dynamics were not yet disease-specific.
legacy_cells.FB: A frozen 3D VQ-GAN encodes MRI volumes into a discrete latent grid; a reverse-order ConvGRU initializes the latent state; a Neural ODE integrates backward; residual latent and frozen image decoders reconstruct earlier frames.
legacy_cells.FL: Frozen 3D VQ-GAN encoder/codebook → discrete latent grid → reverse-order ConvGRU initialization → backward Neural ODE and residual temporal head → latent residual decoder plus frozen image decoder → earlier MRI frames; no planner.
legacy_cells.FM: The authors formulate reverse disease progression prediction and propose a two-stage latent Neural ODE with a frozen discrete representation to reconstruct unseen earlier anatomy from later observations.
legacy_cells.FN: On synthetic Morpho-MNIST, reverse prediction achieved MSE 0.00561±0.00040 and thickness correlation r=0.965. On registered ADNI, Neural ODE SSIM was 0.574 versus 0.454/0.470 for VQ baselines, but disease-reversal scores were negative across strata.
legacy_cells.FO: Authors report a modest ADNI test set, few progressors, deterministic trajectories, non-disease-specific dynamics, no ROI-level biomarker validation, and an autoencoder fidelity ceiling; they state the method is not yet clinically validated.
legacy_cells.FP: Authors propose refinement decoders or diffusion-based super-resolution, uncertainty over plausible past trajectories, and conditioning on diagnosis or biomarkers while preserving spatial standardization.
legacy_cells.FQ: Existing progression models generally forecast forward from an observed baseline; the authors identify a gap in subject-specific reconstruction of an unobserved earlier baseline from later scans.
legacy_cells.FR: The experiments demonstrate retrospective reconstruction of past MRI anatomy, not therapeutic reversal, treatment effects, identified counterfactuals under alternative interventions, early-detection benefit, or a clinically actionable treatment plan.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M6 Rollout service; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Expose future-state forecasts through a time-aware dynamics interface and validate error versus horizon; treatment actions need separate evidence before intervention simulation.
legacy_cells.FX: Complete extracted PDF text, pp. 1–10: title/abstract (p. 1); introduction and related work (pp. 2–3); methods and figures (pp. 3–4); experiments/data and metrics (pp. 5–6); results and Table 1 (pp. 6–8); discussion, limitations, and conclusion (p. 9); references (pp. 9–10). All supplied schema, rubric, and metadata files were also read. Relevant extracted tables and figures were legible in the text. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: The paper is a 2026 arXiv preprint (v1) on reverse reconstruction of earlier MRI anatomy. Prefilled A:I were not changed; no contradiction with the title-page text was found. The paper demonstrates retrospective temporal reconstruction but not treatment-conditioned prediction, causal identification, therapeutic reversal, clinical decision quality, or deployment. Results include an adverse registered-ADNI finding: negative disease-reversal scores and overshooting dynamics. Evidence QA: 56/71 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (78.9%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 69 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 4 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

notes: Reverse disease progression prediction with a two-stage model: a frozen 3D VQ-GAN and a latent Neural ODE driven by a reverse-order ConvGRU encoder. On simulated Morpho-MNIST the model improves MSE over copy-nearest by 74.8 percent. On registered 1 mm ADNI (25 test subjects) it has the best SSIM among VQ-routed methods, but loses to pixel baselines on MSE and has negative disease-reversal scores (about -1.9), so the abstract claim of positive scores in every stratum holds only for unregistered data that the authors call largely an alignment artifact. Classified L1, core. Source points: small test set, mixed registered result, no uncertainty.
